questions.question: Were there more male decedents than female decedents in the records?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('ct_accidental_drug_related_deaths.csv')
counts = df['Sex'].value_counts()
result = 'yes' if counts.get('Male', 0) > counts.get('Female', 0) else 'no'
